name: Get objects plan
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current plan limits and feature flags for the custom objects module in the account. Use the object‑listing action (e.g., objects.list_objects) when you need to work with the actual objects instead of the plan information.

plan_type.description: The type of plan the account is on (e.g., free, paid).

plan_status.description: Current status of the plan (e.g., active, inactive).

object_limit.description: Maximum number of custom objects allowed under the plan.

pricing_version.description: Version identifier for the pricing model.

custom_object_status.description: Whether custom objects are enabled for the account.

crud_release.description: Indicates if CRUD operations on custom objects are released.

crud_associations.description: Indicates if associations between custom objects are supported.

custom_objects_addon_eligible.description: Whether the account is eligible for a custom objects add‑on.

labeled_associations.description: Whether labeled associations are available for custom objects.
